Danish vessel tracks (AIS)

Source: R/datasets.R
dansk.Rd

Each row is an AIS position of one of 14 Danish fishing vessels with four gears, a median 10 s apart, from December 2012 to October 2020, with an expert's label of fishing or other. Read it with rr_example("dansk").

Format

A parquet file of 395,558 rows in the package's extdata folder, dansk.parquet, with the columns:

  • .rowid: Row number, in the order of vessel and time.

  • vessel_id: The vessel, anonymised.

  • time_stamp: Time of the position, as given; the source states no zone.

  • lon: Longitude. Unit: degrees east.

  • lat: Latitude. Unit: degrees north.

  • speed: Speed over ground, knots. Unit: knots.

  • course: Course over ground, degrees, as given; a few values above 360 (up to 33,098) are errors of the source. Unit: degrees.

  • gear: The gear the vessel used. Values: GN gillnet, not specified; GNS set gillnet; GTR trammel net; OTB bottom otter trawl.

  • behaviour: The expert's label of the position. Values: Fishing, Other.

Source

ICES (2022). "Workshop on Geo-Spatial Data for Small-Scale Fisheries (WKSSFGEO)." ICES Scientific Reports 4:10, International Council for the Exploration of the Sea. doi:10.17895/ices.pub.10032 https://doi.org/10.17895/ices.pub.10032.

ICES WKSSFGEO (2021). "WKSSFGEO: code and example data of the ICES Workshop on Geo-Spatial Data for Small-Scale Fisheries." Commit 3da870d. MIT licence, https://github.com/ices-eg/WKSSFGEO.

Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 ICES Expert Groups.

Details

data-examples/example_data_AIS.csv of the WKSSFGEO repository, with repeated (vessel_id, time_stamp) rows dropped and .rowid added (data-raw/DATASET.R).

See also

rr_example(); the data dictionary data-dict.yaml in the package's extdata folder.

Other example data: dansk_harbours, dansk_relief, trawlsurvey, trawlsurveytows
